items.text: 我们的能力包括资源不足以我们自研大模型，那就赌大模型厂商未来的技术突破方向，以此锚定我们要开发APP的核心功能
瞄准大模型时代的“豌豆荚窗口期”，提前布局适配大模型技术突破方向的第三方生态平台，APP及相关应用的分发与服务先机

en.title: Zhang Xiaojun in conversation with Manus CEO Xiao Hong
en.summary: Finding application opportunities around breakthroughs in large language models: two thoughts on core product features, ecosystems, and distribution.
en.source_title: Zhang Xiaojun Jùn · Business Interviews, EP.95: The world is not a linear extrapolation; become an important variable in the game

items.text: Our capabilities and resources are not enough to develop a large language model ourselves. Instead, we can make a bet on the direction of future breakthroughs by model providers and use that to anchor the core features of the app we build.

Look for a “Wandoujia window” in the era of large language models: prepare a third-party ecosystem platform aligned with future model breakthroughs, and get an early start in distributing and servicing apps and related applications.
